transcript.text: A lot of ambitious people say that they
have trouble making friends.
If you are doing exceptional things, is
it inevitably hard to become friends
with people?
>> As you achieve rarer things, you will
have less overlap with people who have
not achieved those things. And if the
vast majority of your time is spent
achieving those rarer things, you'll
have a smaller selection of people who
share that experience.
>> [music]
>> That doesn't mean that you can't talk
about football or talk about family or
talk about relationship because many
people have all of those things.
Um but if you want to be friends with
people who like the things that you
like, then you naturally are going to
have a smaller subgroup.
